description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Drawer' that renders a slide-in side panel (drawer) with accessibility features such as focus trapping and keyboard navigation. It includes TypeScript interfaces for props and links, manages focus and keyboard events via useEffect, and renders a UI with a header, navigation links, and tips.

methods.name: Drawer
methods.description: React functional component for an accessible side drawer panel with focus management and keyboard navigation.
